description: This Java source file defines the 'AuthHelper' utility class, which facilitates authentication operations such as login, logout, user synchronization, and password updates in the Apache Ofbiz framework. It manages a list of 'Authenticator' implementations, loads them dynamically, and provides static methods to invoke authentication-related functionality.

classes.name: AuthHelper
classes.description: A utility class that manages authentication processes such as login, logout, user synchronization, and password management by loading and utilizing various 'Authenticator' implementations.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided username and password, optionally specifying if it's a service authentication.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user identified by username.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a user.

methods.name: authenticatorsLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the authenticators have been loaded.

methods.name: loadAuthenticators
methods.description: Loads available authenticators if not already loaded.
